Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE finished whole-body character alternative for the BlitzWord family review dashboard, not a production replacement. Input image 1 is the existing character lineup: the girl archer is the dark-haired child in the lower row, with green cloak, leather outfit, bow and quiver; girl mage is the red-haired child with staff at upper right. Input image 2 is the rendering/style and portrait framing reference only. Match its richly painted storybook texture, crisp warm detail, child-friendly proportions, forest-green, warm cream, natural leather, subtle ember-red and rowan berry motifs. Exactly one connected full-body figure with two arms, two hands, two legs, both boots fully shown. Neutral standing three-quarter pose, subject fills about 85% of the height, comfortable margin around head, gear and boots, plain warm ivory background and soft grounding shadow, gentle even light. Portrait 2:3 image. No text, labels, panels, borders, extra characters, disconnected body parts, or action scene. Keep bow and hands anatomically coherent; no nocked arrow or aimed weapon. This is a distinct review concept; requested face and hairstyle variations are intentional.
Subject: one girl archer, about 9 years old, with warm medium skin, large expressive brown eyes, a softly rounded face, and dark chestnut curls in two loose low braids with a small rowan-leaf hair clip. Friendly, thoughtful smile. Practical cream long-sleeved shirt, forest-green hooded cape, leather tunic, belt pouches, trousers, fitted bracers, sturdy brown boots. Holds one wooden bow relaxed beside her body, quiver visible. Preserve the approachable woodland archer silhouette.
